The '''Wroona system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Wroona/Legends|Wroona]].<ref name="TCSWE" />

==History==
A [[Battle in the Wroona system|battle]] took place in the outer edges of the Wroona system during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]] when [[Imperial Office of Customs/Legends|Imperial Customs]] vessels engaged a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] fleet.<ref name="PSG">''[[Platt's Starport Guide]]''</ref>
